newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank of Canada again sets specials at 4.25 percent.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Canada again sets specials at 4.25 percent.

text.p: The Bank of Canada on Monday intervened in the money market with a third round of special purchase and resale agreements at 4.25 percent, dealers said.
The central bank intervened for a third time as the call loan or overnight lending rate continued to trade at the top of the Bank of Canada's 3.75-4.25 percent target range.
Dealers cited technical pressures associated with month end and dislocation within the system as being responsible for the intervention.
"There are some dislocations in the system," said one Toronto-based dealer.
After the intervention, the call loan rate was bid at 4.25 percent.
